# Find Your Destiny

Canonical play URL: https://kids-find-your-destiny.vercel.app/
Repository: https://github.com/Joenasriani/kids-find-your-destiny

Find Your Destiny is a five-question fantasy personality-style game for children, used in the children’s-event game family. Each run randomly selects five questions from a fifteen-question bank, counts YES answers, maps the count to one of three result pools, and randomly selects one themed character result from that pool.

The mechanic resembles a light personality quiz. The repository does not present its results as a validated psychological, educational, aptitude, or diagnostic assessment.
